answers.core: There is actually an add-on for this! [Globalize Plugins](https://godotengine.org/asset-library/asset/2681) by dugramen implements a system for globally-loaded editor plugins. However, *it is still itself a local plugin*, requiring you to set it up again for every new project and keep it in your version management. I believe this is insufficient, and a proper global solution is still necessary.
answers.workaround:
I think this *would* be used pretty often! Plugin Refresher isn't the only editor plugin that would benefit from being global. Others include:
- [vim-motion](https://godotengine.org/asset-library/asset/3127) by wovrik - Vim keybindings are a personal decision, and adding it to a project would force them onto all collaborators due to the aforementioned `plugin.godot` problem.
- [Local asset browser](https://github.com/Kaifungamedev/godot_local_assets_browser) by kaifungamedev - the same GPLv3 problem as Plugin Refresher; the code shouldn't have to be included in VCS where it could violate the GPL license.
- [Quick layout changer](https://godotengine.org/asset-library/asset/3133) by mathrick - this only affects the editor and shouldn't need to be bundled with the final compiled game.

title: Add support for external/global editor plugins
